ℹ️ About Highway Ticketing System
The Highway Ticketing System is a desktop application designed to streamline the process of managing vehicle entries and exits on highways. It allows entrance point employees to register vehicles entering the highway and exit point employees to efficiently generate bills for vehicles leaving. The system ensures accurate tracking of each vehicle’s journey, proper toll calculation, and secure record-keeping of both employee and vehicle data. This project aims to make highway operations faster, more reliable, and easier to manage for all staff involved.
